compareHub.explainerTitle: How to compare online store platforms
compareHub.explainer: Online store platforms price differently: some charge a monthly subscription, others a fee per order or a share of your sales. They also differ on cash on delivery, connections to local shipping companies, the language of their templates and dashboard, and how you reach support in Arabic. In each comparison here we only show the differences we could verify, say what each platform does well and give the date we last checked, so you can decide based on what your store needs.

steps.link: How do I connect my domain?

price.a: On Tallaby you start on the Free plan with no monthly subscription and pay {orderFee} per order, or choose Pro at {pro} a month with no order fee.

move.q: Can I move my products from {name} to Tallaby?
move.a: Yes. You can import from an Excel file or a product link, and Shopify stores have a direct import.

domain.q: Will I lose my domain if I move?
domain.a: No. You can connect a domain you own to your main Tallaby store and update its DNS records. The domain stays yours.

try.q: Can I try Tallaby before closing my current store?
try.a: Yes. You can set up and test your store on Tallaby with no monthly subscription, then move when you're ready. To see orders, you need a first {topUpMin} wallet top-up.

methods.q: What payment and shipping options does Tallaby have?
methods.a: Cash on delivery is on from the start. You can connect Paymob or Kashier for cards and wallets, and take InstaPay and wallet transfers straight to your account. For shipping, connect your Bosta account, download the Wassalha sheet or use your own riders.

how.q: How did you put this comparison together?
how.a: We used information published up to the date shown, and we only show what we could verify. If you find something wrong about {name}, email {email} and we'll correct it.
